item.title: GOP blames California electeds for wildfires in hearings
item.description: Wisconsin Republican Ron Johnson formed a Senate subcommittee to investigate the Los Angeles fires at the request of Sen. Rick Scott, R-Fla.

item.title: Utah crude oil train angles for $2.8 billion RRIF loan
item.description: The push for a Railroad Rehabilitation and Improvement Financing loan comes as opponents call for a full review of the railway over concerns about oil spills.

item.title: Charter school bonds demand deeper credit work as state support and demographics shift
item.description: Market Intelligence analyst Jeff Lipton analyzes how varied state funding priorities and overall charter school support, shifting enrollment patterns, policy uncertainty, charter renewal risk, and varied pension practices affect charter school bond security—and outlines what issuers, advisors and investors should be communicating to the market.

item.title: Ex-Brightline CFO joins Texas toll road concessionaire SH 130
item.description: Jeff Swiatek joins as CFO as the Texas toll road is looking to invest in the Austin-San Antonio corridor.

item.title: Tribes stymied by regulations
item.description: Native American Tribes are working from a disadvantage in bond sales due to Securities and Exchange Commission regulations that force them to register public market issuances, which raises costs.

item.title: Puerto Rico legislature approves $554 million tax rebate
item.description: The government plans to use surplus funds from fiscal years 2022 to 2024 to fund the payments.

item.title: Steven Mahr steps in as Chicago's acting CFO, sources say
item.description: Chicago Mayor Brandon Johnson has chosen Assistant Finance Commissioner Steven Mahr as the city's acting chief financial officer, two sources confirmed.

item.title: Issuers, dealers disagree on MSRB SMMP proposal
item.description: "This would be an unnecessary change that would be difficult to administer and comply with and which would severely limit municipal entity choice," the Bond Dealers of America said in a comment letter.

item.title: Munis richen on front end, USTs barely move
item.description: Supply should be "well-received, given strong inflows and the increase in reinvestment capital for the new month," said Chris Brigati, managing director and CIO at SWBC, and Ryan Riffe, senior vice president of capital markets at the firm.
